system: Multizone VAV Air Handling Unit AHU-4

errors.description: 3.4.1: setpt variant planted: Stage 1: when supply air temperature stays below 35 °F for 5 minutes, the controller sends two heating hot water plant requests, holds the outdoor air damper at minimum position and modulates the heating coil to maintain at least 42 °F; stage 1 ends after the supply air temperature is above 45 °F for 5 minutes.

3.4.3: contra variant planted: Stage 3: on a freeze-stat trip, or when supply air temperature is below 38 °F for 15 minutes or below 34 °F for 5 minutes, the supply and return fans stop, the outdoor air dampers close, the cooling coil valve closes, the chilled water pumps are energized and a Level 2 alarm reports a freeze protection shutdown.
